reviewer_notes: Split out from RTO-STR-001 (over-consolidated strategic staging row) per the anti-overconsolidation check. Named, live generative-AI product (Google Gemini AI for Google Workspace) rolled out to the entire c.63,400-strong global workforce ('all colleagues worldwide had access' by end of 2025), with a quantified usage figure (over one million uses in six months) -- matches live_scaled/3_strong. Distinct from the not-yet-live 'AI Portal'/RatGPT agent platform described in the same AR section (captured separately as RTO-STR-002), and from PestConnect Optix (a computer-vision/image-recognition rodent-detection tool -- predictive AI, not generative, and correctly left rejected/unclassified).
